description: Fetches one Federal Register document by its document number (for example 2025-02006): type, agencies, publication and signing dates, FR citation, effective date, comment deadline, docket and the official govinfo PDF. For compliance teams, lawyers and researchers who have the document number from a notice, docket or URL and want the primary record rather than a secondary summary. Source: the Federal Register (FederalRegister.gov API). It needs the document number: it does not resolve a page citation such as 90 FR 8443, and it does not return the full text (follow html_url or pdf_url). (cost: 1 credit)

document_number.description: string, required, Federal Register document number, e.g. 2025-02006 (not an FR page citation such as 90 FR 8443)

name: federal_register_document
